Name: Final Judgement
Components: V, M (a rose thorn to pierce into the palm of your hand)
Description:
*“Drown in the heart-torn world of nothingness! I shall scatter your heart to the empty winds!”*

You pierce your hand with the rose's thorn, letting your blood drip and nourish the ground to grant your foes their imminent doom. Upon casting this spell, choose a target within reach to be judged, forcing them to pass a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a pool of shadow appears underneath them and erupts with a trio of dark thorns, dealing 3d6 piercing damage and lodging them with four Thorns for the spell's duration. On a success, they manage to dodge, taking half the damage that would be dealt and being lodged with a single Thorn.

While concentrating on this spell, you may spend your Action to force the same target or another one within reach to attempt this Wisdom saving throw again, to the same effects.

When this spell ends you may spend your Reaction to harvest the ground you have fed, causing a final rose to burst out under a target, extending its scythe-like thorns and whirling around violently. All targets within 15-ft. of the original target must pass a Dexterity saving throw or be sliced at, suffering 2d12 slashing damage and an additional d12 force damage for each 2 Thorns lodged in them, or half that damage on a success.
